_meta.source_note: Facts marked [VERIFIED] come from IIT Ropar's own site, Wikipedia, or student-review aggregators (searched July 2026). Facts marked [ASSUMED] are standard IIT-campus conventions used as placeholders because the exact figure (e.g. precise closing time of some buildings is not available and depends on the event) is not published anywhere public — replace with real values once you can check a hostel notice board / library circular.
campus_facts: 525 acres, permanent campus operational since June 2018, on the bank of the Sutlej river, Rupnagar, Punjab
Entrance gate: four,41-ft Indus-Valley-style stone pillars, built with ASI
Three main academic blocks connected via skywalks (SAB)
Major fests: Zeitgeist (cultural, Oct/Nov, 3 days), Aadvitya (tech fest, Feb), Aarohan (sports fest, March), Malhar (literary fest, September)

locations.name: Nalanda Central Library
locations.notes: Reference section runs 24/7 and the library is fully open round-the-clock during exams; runs on the Koha ILMS; 22,000+ physical books plus e-journals (Scopus, Web of Science). Seat booking via a dedicated portal (studyatlib).

locations.name: Super Academic Block
locations.notes: [VERIFIED] Three independent blocks connected by skywalks, smart/digitally-equipped classrooms, department-specific labs. [ASSUMED] 08:00-18:00 weekday window follows standard IIT timetable slots; exact IIT Ropar bell schedule not published.

locations.name: Lecture Hall Complex
locations.notes: [VERIFIED] Used for hosting lectures, academic sessions, club sessions, hackathons, cultural events and guest lectures. [ASSUMED] 08:00-18:00 weekday window follows standard IIT timetable slots; exact IIT Ropar bell schedule not published.

locations.notes: [VERIFIED] 1 cricket field, 2 clay tennis courts, 3 cricket practice pitches, 2 volleyball courts, hockey field, football field, 1 basketball court, gymnasium, plus open athletics ground. Gymkhana runs Inter-IIT sports program. [ASSUMED] Daily open window (06:00-20:00) is a typical daylight-sports default.

locations.notes: [VERIFIED] Open 24/7 with dedicated medical/paramedical staff and round-the-clock ambulance. Note: 'administrative' is the closest fit in your current enum — worth adding a dedicated 'healthcare' type (see comments).

open_hours.note: Hours are event-driven — open only during scheduled seminars/cultural events

locations.notes: [VERIFIED] Modern, tech-equipped venue for seminars, lectures, and cultural events (used heavily during Zeitgeist/Aadvitya). Hours are inherently event-driven rather than fixed — flag this to your planner as a scheduled-event location, not an always-open one.

locations.name: Central Lawn / Open Green
locations.notes: [ASSUMED as a generic hub] Real campus does have large green/lawn zones (Sivalik-hill views cited in multiple sources) but this node is a simplification acting as your graph's central 'plaza' — genuinely useful for a tick-loop since it lets agents cross zones without every building being pairwise-connected.

locations.name: Administrative Block
locations.notes: [VERIFIED] Existence and function (registrar, DoSW, accounts) confirmed via IIT Ropar's own pages. [ASSUMED] Standard govt-institute office hours (09:30-17:30) since exact hours aren't published.

locations.name: Main Entrance Gate
locations.notes: [VERIFIED] Distinctive Indus-Valley-style pyramid pillar entrance; institute runs a paid shuttle bus to Chandigarh/Mohali. Useful as your graph's 'exit node' if you ever want agents to leave campus (weekend trip, going home, etc.).
